51539118.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to PCLAF (unknown origin) assessed as equilibrium dissociation constant by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - SPR Assay: 4.12. SPR Assay. Compounds bound to PCLAF protein were determined using the Biacore X100 system. PCLAF protein (50 mg/mL) was dissolved in sodium acetate buffer (pH 5.5) and immobilized on a CMS sensor chip that was pre-activated 420 s with an EDC/NHS mixture at a flow rate of 1 mL/min. The compounds were diluted to different concentrations at 1.05X PBS of 5% DMSO and bound to PCLAF protein at a flow rate of 10 mL/min. The binding phase of SM1044 was 60 s, and it was then dissociated for 150 s; the binding phase of AD4 was 100 s, and it was then dissociated for 150 s. The dissociation constant KD was fitted by Biacore X100 analysis software.
original_paragraph.Figure 7 caption: Figure 7. PCLAF is the target of the artemisinin derivative, AD4. (A,B) CETSA and DARTS assay to detect the stability of PCLAF. Data from two independent experiments. (C,D) SPR assays to measure the binding affinity between PCLAF protein and SM1044 or AD4. (E) Western blot analysis of p-Rb, p21, and anti-apoptosis-related proteins upon the treatment of compound AD4 in RS4;11 cells. Data from two independent experiments. (F,G) Proposed binding mode of compound SM1044 or AD4 to PCLAF.
